text:
Yes, under the standard rules: the host knows where the car is, always opens a goat door you didn't pick, and always offers the switch. Your first pick is right 1/3 of the time, and the host's reveal doesn't change that, so the other unopened door holds the remaining 2/3.

The caveat is that the result depends on those rules. If the host opens a door at random and happens to reveal a goat, switching is 50/50. If the host offers the switch only when you've picked the car, switching always loses.
